own_solution.law: Doppler reflection from a moving wall: echo f(c+v)/(c-v); beat = 2fv/(c-v)
assumptions: wall speed relative to a stationary trolley

notes: Agrees with pass 1. Checked R answers: 2*440*3.7/339.3 = 9.5962, 2*440*4.4/338.6 = 11.4353, 2*440*5.2/337.8 = 13.5465 Hz. The crest-timing cancellation gives T_(n+1) - T_n = (1/f)(c-v)/(c+v), independent of the initial distance, so the echo frequency is f(c+v)/(c-v) for any distance; the C claim holds. Minimal pairs T105F-T2729 and T811A-T7F76 share 1.4 m/s and differ only in attachment/occasion; T544D and T1B41 are declared numeral-free twins. The trolley clause makes the base wall speed relative to a stationary trolley, so trolley motion adds to the wall's speed through the air.
